rebuild_required: Recompute training labels restricted to April13-May4; cannot merely reuse labels aggregated through May18.
Build May4 snapshot using only pre-May4 history, historical metadata available by cutoff, and known schedule context.
All target proxies use their own fixed window aggregation and deterministic ties.
Freeze model candidates and target variants before viewing new comparison.
recommended_temporal_design.leakage_rule: Fit uses only earlier labels. Early-stop labels control iteration/hyperparameters only, never features or gradient updates. Any later refit including stop period requires fixed selected iteration count and separate reporting.
recommended_temporal_design.limits: New split boundaries do not make underlying observations unseen: these weeks were already used in previous fits; report improved temporal separation, not pristine holdout. Stop horizon2weeks vs fit3weeks and outer10weeks introduces horizon shift.

allocation: At most2 feature-ablation fits with prespecified best configuration, same early-stop period.
At most2 fixed-iteration refits on existing full early label window after choices frozen.
2fits reserve only for justified correction/repeat, not open-ended search.
bounded_fit_budget.metric: Select using explicitly fixed full-truth-denominator macro MAP@5; standard built-in MAP on retrieved shortlist may use wrong denominator. Use custom callback or clearly state NDCG@5 stopping proxy plus own MAP reporting.
bounded_fit_budget.group_filter: Keep positive-and-negative query groups for training if retaining existing convention; evaluate complete cohort including empty truth and fixed cold fallback.
bounded_fit_budget.selection: Choose within each target by its own early-stop score; report both target scores and broad-viewing score outside. Do not choose target definition because its absolute MAP is larger.
bounded_fit_budget.resource_note: Earlier fits fast, but 2000tree cost and rebuilt features not measured. Stop before exceeding limits; log elapsed time, rows, memory, iteration and thread count.
